svg.title: From draft to finalised
svg.desc: A new promotion list starts as a draft. In the draft you can change decisions, update it from the results, or delete it, and no student changes. Pressing Finalise, after extra approval if anything was changed by hand, moves everyone at once: those who pass go to the next class, those retained go to a class of the same level, and graduates become Graduated. After finalising it cannot be undone.
